ns2:course.label: Spanish Studies 1898-1960
ns2:course.description: Selected literary and non-literary texts published in Spain between 1898-1960. Focus on analysis of literary and other manifestations of major cultural movements and artistic currents and preoccupations. Instruction in Spanish unless otherwise noted. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 undergraduate hours or 8 graduate hours if topics vary. Prerequisite: SPAN 312 and SPAN 320 or consent of instructor.
